The objective of [[Ruins of Morah]] is simply to kill [[Varesh]] in one last attempt to prevent her from bringing about Nightfall.

You will fight against Varesh twice; during the first part, she fights you as [[Prophet Varesh]], utilizing powerful [[AoE]] skills. The second part consists of fighting [[Commander Varesh]] as she leads [[Abaddon]]'s demons to battle.

==Mission information==

===Requirements===
* All party members must have accepted the reward for [[Horde of Darkness]].
* [[General Morgahn]] must be present in the party.

===Objective===
Kill Varesh.

== Walkthrough ==
[[File:Commander Varesh.jpg|thumb|Commander Varesh]]
The dervish form of [[Prophet Varesh]] is awaiting the ritual to break Abaddon's prison with three [[Margonite Cleric]]s in the middle of the crater. Kill the clerics first or pull her away alone. 

====Recommended: hold the entrance====
Killing her is easy—but she will be resurrected after with a variety of [[Torment creature]]s—so it is recommended to fight away from the crater and close to the entry point of the mission. Use anti-melee skills (i.e. [[blind]], [[Snare (tactic)|snare]]s and/or [[knock down]]s). Do not stand in either of her [[Earth Vortex|Earth]] or [[Frost Vortex|Frost Vortices]].

There is a short interval between her first death and her new form as the paragon [[Commander Varesh]]. Use the time delay to rush back towards your entry point and [[Hero flag|flag]] [[henchmen]]/[[hero]]es. The new form will not leash as far, so staying next to the door will cause her to run back to the centre of the crater where she spawns. [[Torment creature]]s with the skill [[Call to the Torment]] (which allows them to duplicate) appear around the crater and start to patrol counter-clockwise. Her new form also has a monster skill called [[Enemies Must Die!]] which will focus all of the torment creatures' attacks on one of your allies - just like players targeting priority foes for heroes. Either take out a few demons first to finally strike her, or focus your entire firepower on her to kill her as quickly as possible. The second death of Varesh ends the mission. 

Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier. 

====Alternative: hold the center====
Do not use [[summoning stone]]s, spirits, or [[minion]]s for this method.

Using caster heroes and henchmen only, move to where Varesh initially spawns in the mission. After killing the Clerics and then the first form of Varesh, instead of flagging your allies atop the hill, keep them with you in the center. If you stay in the center, most of the torment demons should patrol around the area without aggroing your party. Some demons might wander into your [[Danger Zone]] but by that time they hopefully shouldn't represent much of a threat. 

=== Skill recommendations ===
* Display your [[Lightbringer]] title and bring [[Lightbringer's Gaze]].
* [[Melee counter]], [[blind]], [[punish]]ment hexes (such as [[Spoil Victor]] and [[Visions of Regret]]) for Varesh.
* [[Inspired Hex]] or [[Revealed Hex]] to quickly remove Varesh's hexes, since they recharge instantly due to being [[monster skill]]s.
* [[Pain Inverter]] can hurt Varesh because of her various powerful skills.
* [[Party]] wide and single protective skills like [[Shield of Absorption]] and [[Spirit Bond]] to counter the [[spike]] from enemies when Varesh uses [[Enemies Must Die!]].
* [[Ursan Blessing]] is extremely helpful and easy way to defeat both first and second versions of Varesh.
